bootstrap.rule: Detect first, preserve existing architecture, persist only non-secret project metadata, and never reinstall a valid configured project without a reason.

selfCheck.rule: Run both after changing kit files, templates, manifest contracts, or bootstrap scripts; both must report ok: true. The repository-local Lefthook pre-commit guard runs both automatically once enabled with `npx lefthook install`.

uiUx.activation: Load only for user-facing UI/UX work; choose the smallest applicable subset from README.md.

policy.packageManagerRule: Use the package manager selected by the existing lockfile.
policy.stackRule: Detect and preserve the existing architecture. Do not force Supabase, Neon, Drizzle, Prisma, Vercel, or any other provider merely because it appears in this kit.

rules: expand context only when a dependency requires it
do not reread unchanged files without a reason
use Repomix only for architecture-wide or genuinely broad tasks

tools.installScope: HTTP API; no local installation required

databaseOptions.when: Managed PostgreSQL is needed without Supabase platform features
Postgres plus Auth, Storage, Realtime, or Supabase platform features are useful
Self-hosted or another managed PostgreSQL provider is selected

databaseAccessOptions.when: Type-safe SQL-oriented ORM/query builder is useful
The project already uses Prisma or its data model fits the project
Direct PostgreSQL access is simpler or existing architecture already uses it
Provider SDK or another existing access layer is already authoritative

cloud.when: Deploying Next.js or using Vercel Preview/Functions
Durable background workflows, retries, waits, or concurrency controls are required
A shared or production project benefits from remote verification on push/PR
Production errors, traces, and runtime health need visibility
